name: USAGIRI
source:
In the near future, bunny girls appeared on our planet. They are calm, harmless and fluffy. That's why the Bunnies Assimilation Program has been established.

You were asked to become a patron - a person who takes care of bunny girls and show them how to live in our society. Your new roommates turn your life upside down!

Meet two friends, curious and clueless Misty and shy walking encyclopedia Windy, as they live with you.

Will you fulfill your duty as a patron? Will they become good citizens? Find out in this Visual Novel!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1153950/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在不久的将来，兔耳少女出现在了我们的星球上。她们温顺、无害，浑身毛茸茸的。为此，“兔耳少女社会融入计划”应运而生。

你受邀成为一名照料者，负责照顾兔耳少女，教她们如何在我们的社会中生活。新室友们让你的生活发生了翻天覆地的变化！

和这对朋友一起生活吧：米丝蒂充满好奇却又懵懵懂懂，温蒂则是一部害羞的活百科全书。

你能尽到照料者的职责吗？她们能成为好公民吗？来这部视觉小说中寻找答案吧！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1153950/]Steam[/url]]
